question: How much will Nasdaq-100 Futures total price returns exceed S&P 500 Futures in these biweekly periods of Q4 2026? (Nov 9 - Nov 20)

calls.reasoning: Reference class: biweekly NQ minus ES total return gaps, centred near zero with a slight positive long-run drift. In normal regimes the standard deviation is about 1-1.2pp. Right now tech is much more volatile than the broad market: on Oct 30 NQ fell 3.46% vs ES -1.82%, and NQ is down ~8% since Oct 9 on AI-trade rotation and earnings misses (Intel, AMD). Nvidia reports on Nov 17, inside the window, so the spread is widened to about 1.9pp SD. The median stays near zero because mean-reversion and rebound (NQ +0.88% vs ES +0.45% early Nov 2) offset negative momentum. Market check: the harness found nothing on Polymarket or Manifold, and I found no Kalshi or bookmaker contract for this spread. I could not pull the Yahoo price series directly, so the dispersion figures are estimates rather than computed from data.
